function calcAspectScaled(width, height, maxWidth): number

Defined in: core/utils/aspect.ts:18

Calculates aspect-ratio scaled height while preserving proportions. Formula: height_out = (h/w) × maxWidth — the intrinsic ratio (h/w) scaled to the bounding width. Rounded to an integer pixel so it can land directly on a style/attribute. Returns the raw height (or 0) when any input is missing rather than NaN — callers render height || fallback.

width
